channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Single-tenant Titus: VM-level isolation on a multi-tenant container platform
Article: Multi-Cloud FinOps: An Engineering Framework for Cross-Cloud Cost Optimization
item.description: Multi-cloud flexibility comes with hidden egress costs driven by service placement and communication patterns. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Move Fast, Don’t Break Trust: Shipping Constantly with Humans and Beyond
item.description: Suhail Patel discusses how Monzo structures its software engineering organization and technical stack to ship safely hundreds of times a day. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Localizing compliance at scale: achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
item.description: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: How bug bounty sharpens one researcher’s security skills
item.description: As Cybersecurity Awareness Month continues, the GitHub Bug Bounty team spotlights @r31n, diving into their research approach, favorite bug classes, and advice for aspiring hackers. (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Building what's next
item.description: This week I'm talking with Zeno Rocha, CEO of Resend, about scaling "boring" email to 3 million users, the secret Go rewrite behind it, and building for agents. (1 source: changelog)

item.title: Trends from Money20/20 2026: The rise of “hidden” financial services
item.description: As fintech products become increasingly capable, the infrastructure behind them fades into the background. Three trends from Money20/20 show how stablecoins, agents, and always-on money are changing financial services. (1 source: stripe)
